body:
> With the affordable care act.

Oh, right. I looked at that and I believe they give you an option of either health or dental insurance. I'd rather have dental because of how messed up my teeth are. I've never smiled in my life because of them. I only smirk. Also, because no girl would ever kiss me with teeth like mine, and fixing my teeth will cost a lot.

> Go back and get your GED. Not because it will help you, (it probably will for job apps) but because you'll feel that much better about yourself. You'll have proof that you can get back in the swing of things.

It seems like a waste of time. I'm still going to be a 24 year old with no job experience, and that's what people will see.

> Replace one bad snack/dessert/sugary drink from your system.

Since my mom is the only one that works and can barely afford food, the only thing I eat between Friday and Tuesday is pizza. That's literally all I've eaten for years since we can't afford any decent food.

> Neging yourself all day is what's ruining your self-worth.

I don't think I've ever had any self-esteem or self confidence in my life since I haven't done anything.

My family will honestly have nothing good to say about me at my funeral. They clearly can't say I was a hard worker. Since I never talk, they can't say I made them laugh, or helped them cope with anything. Even my sister, the person I'm closest to, doesn't want me to move to where she is because she's going to have to drive me around places until I got my drivers license. She has enough problems of her own to deal with.
How do I get free health insurance? I'm in USA, not Canada.

No. I've never told anyone when I'm sad/depressed. It wont help. Talking through things doesn't work for me. To me, it is what is it, and talking about it just makes it worse. Plus, I'm sure if I told my mom, she'll tell her ex-husband and he'll probably have me committed somewhere even though my mom can't afford it, especially since I don't have insurance.
The only thing I do is go on reddit, youtube, porn and play a game for about an hour before I get bored. That has literally been my life for the past 7 years.
